aspect: The role is the whole standing
description: Where worth is measured by provision, losing the income removes the basis of his position in the family rather than reducing the budget.
Admitting he cannot lift it any more (OCC-002) threatens the role as well as the job, so pain is concealed from the family and the foreman alike.
energy_note: Hiding the back from his wife and his boss.

description: REM-002's requests cannot be declined without the refusal being read as a failure of the role, so he borrows rather than says no.
energy_note: Borrowing in order not to have to refuse.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the phone call he does not make
description: He lost the contract on Tuesday. It is Sunday and he has not told them. He calls at the usual hour, asks about his mother's knee, says work is fine, and sends money he has borrowed at 18%.
energy_note: Sends borrowed money rather than say the sentence.
